data.one_liner: Create RPG-style games and similar 2D games using Flame engine.
data.what_it_does: Bonfire is an RPG maker built on top of Flame. It provides ready-to-use components such as Player, Enemy, Ally, and NPC, along with Tiled map support, collisions, input controls, combat mechanics, and behavior trees.
use_when: You want to build a 2D RPG, top-down, or similar style game in Flutter.
You want to leverage Flame engine with higher-level RPG abstractions like paths, quests, and dialogues.
avoid_when: You are building a standard non-game business application or UI-heavy app.
strengths: Comprehensive RPG-ready components and mixins (collision, attack, movement, sensors).
Tiled map support and pathfinding built-in.
Actively maintained with a structured API-first architecture.
weaknesses: Steep learning curve if you are unfamiliar with game development or Flame.
Major version updates can introduce breaking changes to the API surface.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and initialize within a BonfireWidget or Flame game loop.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick raw Flame if you want full control over your game engine architecture without pre-packaged RPG abstractions.
